name: Will improving ventilation void my roof warranty?

mainEntity.name: Will improving ventilation void my roof warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Improperly installed ventilation or modifications that deviate from manufacturer specifications can potentially void your roof warranty. It is crucial to have any ventilation improvements performed by a qualified and certified roofing contractor. Always confirm that the contractor is familiar with your specific roofing material's warranty requirements and uses appropriate installation methods to avoid any warranty issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Improperly installed ventilation can void a roof warranty; always use a qualified contractor familiar with warranty requirements.
